title: ak lease ls --json (leases-v1)
description: Every active (unexpired) advisory account lease on this machine, oldest first. Leases grant nothing: ak pick --owner and the orchestration skill respect them. Holds profile names, owner addresses, times and a purpose note; never a secret value or a path. Additional keys may appear in later minor versions.

cli.description: The account's usage row owner (CLI or provider id).

exclusive.description: The account takes one lease at a time (providers.toml lease = "exclusive": Codex).

kind.description: The kind named when the lease was taken.
